Description: Establish user authentication identity and scoped RBAC permissions.
Acceptance Criteria: All auth and RBAC requirements satisfied.

Description: Manage trips destination routes and collaborator rosters.
Acceptance Criteria: Trip creation and destination routing operational.

Description: Schedule daily activities and assign tasks to members.
Track expenses calculate splits and reconcile group debts.
Acceptance Criteria: Zero-sum split ledger and settlements operational.

Description: As a traveler, I want to create an account with email and strong password, so that my travel plans are securely isolated.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid email and 8+ char password, When I register, Then an account is created and password hashed with bcrypt.

Description: As a registered traveler, I want to log in and receive a secure token, so that I can interact with the API securely.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid credentials, When I log in, Then a signed JWT token is issued with 24h expiration.

Description: As a trip organizer, I want to create a new trip plan, so that I am designated as the trip Owner.
Acceptance Criteria: Given authenticated user, When creating a trip, Then trip is saved and creator is assigned 'owner' role.

Description: As a platform security architect, I want role-based middleware, so that unauthorized mutations are blocked with 403.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a user with viewer role, When attempting to mutate data, Then server returns 403 Forbidden and logs security alert.

Description: As a trip planner, I want to add multiple destination stops with dates, so that my travel route is clearly mapped.
Acceptance Criteria: Given owner or editor role, When adding a destination stop, Then destination is saved in orderIndex sequence.

Description: As a trip owner, I want to invite members and assign Editor or Viewer roles, so that companions can collaborate.
Acceptance Criteria: Given trip owner, When inviting registered user with role, Then membership is stored and audit event logged.

Description: As an editor, I want to schedule day-by-day activities with time and location, so that the group has a clear schedule.
Acceptance Criteria: Given owner or editor, When scheduling an activity, Then item is saved under the specified day number.

Description: As an itinerary planner, I want to assign specific activities to collaborators, so that duties are delegated.
Acceptance Criteria: Given active collaborator, When assigned to activity, Then assignee avatar and name are displayed.

Summary: Group Expense Logging with Payer Designation
Description: As a traveler, I want to record shared expenses with categories and payers, so that group costs are tracked.
Acceptance Criteria: Given positive amount, When expense is logged, Then payer is credited and split group recorded.

Description: As a traveler, I want equal expense splitting among members, so that everyone pays their fair share.
Acceptance Criteria: Given total cost and N members, When split is calculated, Then sum of all member shares equals total exactly.

Description: As a group, I want to know 'Who Owes Whom' with minimal transactions, so that settling debts is simple.
Acceptance Criteria: Given debtor and creditor balances, When settlement is requested, Then minimum transaction graph is generated.

Description: As a security auditor, I want tamper-evident logs of logins and role modifications, so that actions are traceable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given security events, When action occurs, Then log entry is stored with actor IP timestamp and status.
